messages:
julie_sales: Heads-up — Haven (healthcare) POC kickoff. They submitted two variants: haven-lite-int8 and haven-guardian-qat. Req: Dedicated + Hosted failover, steady 35 qps, p95 <210ms (lite) and <750ms (guardian). They also want BYO-KMS, SIEM log export, and a committed price to include in their procurement packet. @omar_eng @tara_ml @ben_prod @sam_sre

omar_eng: Thanks. Can they confirm max_seq and tokenizer? Also ask for a plain PyTorch load path; QAT/fused kernels often break our optimized paths.

julie_sales: Max seq = 4096, tokenizer = HF BPE with 3k vocab. They mentioned "fused attention kernels" in notes but no external CUDA libs. They want deterministic outputs for a subset of flows.

tara_ml: 4k seq + KV cache == memory pressure. If the QAT fused attention alters KV layout we might need an unfused checkpoint or an adapter shim. Request: (1) plain torch checkpoint, (2) fused checkpoint if available, (3) 200-example labeled eval for determinism.

ben_prod: Onboarding plan: 1) compat scan (loader + forward) 2) perf profile (batch sizes, kv configs) 3) quant sweep for lite 4) canary Dedicated -> enable Hosted fallback. Owners: @omar_eng scan, @tara_ml quant/evals, @ben_prod rollout, @sam_sre infra/KMS.

omar_eng: For the scan I'll need a small synthetic checkpoint (50-150MB), tokenizer files, and a minimal loader script. Please provide expected input shapes so we can validate KV memory layout. Prefer S3 with tight ACLs.

sam_sre: Infra notes: 35 qps batched likely 1-2 reserved optimized nodes for lite, 2-3 for guardian depending on multi-card. BYO-KMS supported in Dedicated/Private; Hosted requires enterprise onboarding (~2-3 weeks). We can push logs to customer SIEM via our log-forwarder. I'll run a quick cost sim once batch size mix is known.

julie_sales: Can we give a quick committed price placeholder to their procurement team?

ben_prod: Quick ballpark: lite ~ "$11k/mo" (single optimized reserved), guardian ~ "$34k/mo" (multi-card). Mark as preliminary until perf runs.

tara_ml: Also flag: determinism checks — we need their labeled set with expected outputs and a note on whether sampling is allowed. We'll run regen + deterministic-seed checks and return a short regression report.

sam_sre: Ops note: scheduled maintenance Fri 02:00-03:00 UTC might overlap with canary; we'll pick windows accordingly. KMS onboarding ticket template ready — I can send.

julie_sales: Timeline proposed to Haven: send artifacts today (weights + plain/fused loader + tokenizer + eval set), we run compat scan Tue-Wed, perf/quant Thu, canary Dedicated Fri (if scans pass). KMS prod onboarding 2-3 weeks. Agreed?

omar_eng: Ack. I'll prioritize the scan and queue infra. If fused ops show incompatibility we'll push for unfused checkpoint to avoid delays.

tara_ml: Ack. I'll prep quant sweep templates and eval harness.

notifierbot: Reminder: security questionnaire uploaded to thread. Please attach answers for retention, logs, and key management.

julie_sales: Great — I'll post S3 links and the SQ answers once I have them. :thumbsup:
